messages:
Priya: Heads-up: legal found a few doc examples that look like real PII. With the v1->v2 API deprecation and model alias swap next month we need a short migration guide, sanitized snippets for TS/py/curl, and a quick link audit.
Owen: I can run a repo grep for emails, phone patterns, and API key-like strings and replace them with <EMAIL>/<PHONE>/<REDACTED_KEY>. Will open small preview PRs.
Sofia: SDK breaking notes to call out: models.generate -> responses.create; createEmbedding(dimension=...) -> embeddings.create(vector_dim=...). I'll prepare concise side-by-side snippets and a minimal compatibility table.
Marco: Samples used in onboarding are priority. I'll update those READMEs and the quickstart model table (open-quant-7b -> redwood-q-7b). Also add deprecation banners on v1 pages linking to the migration guide.
legal-bot: Please replace any literal personal data with synthetic tokens and add footer: "Examples sanitized for privacy." Tagging @legal-team for quick review.
Owen: Plan: 1) scripted replace + diff report, 2) manual pass for false positives, 3) incremental PRs with preview builds. Branch: docs/sanitize-3267.
Sofia: Snippet sketch for the guide:
```bash
# v1 curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hi"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_KEY>'
# v2 curl
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/responses -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"hi"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_KEY>'
```
Sofia: And embedding param example: v1 used `dimension`, v2 uses `vector_dim` -- will show both.
Marco: CI note: doc-runner expects v1 call names; it'll fail smoke tests unless we add a short shim to accept both during the transition. I'll add `tools/doc-runner/shim-v1-to-v2.js`.
Priya: Assignments: Owen (sanitize script + PRs), Sofia (snippets + migration guide draft), Marco (samples + doc-runner shim + redirects), Priya (legal coord + final QA). Please paste PR links here as you open them.
Owen: Ack. I'll post incremental PRs so legal can review small batches.
Sofia: I'll include a short changelog blurb: "Deprecate v1 API. Migrate to responses.create and embeddings.create with vector_dim. See migration guide for scripts and examples."
Priya: Timeline: start PRs tomorrow, merge small batches through the week, banners on staging by Friday. Keep changes small and previewable.
ci-bot: placeholder preview build queued: https://ci.internal.redwood/preview/3267
Priya: Thanks team  drop PR links here and mark the migration checklist when items are merged.
